unsettled: The current consolidated Schedule could not be read. CBN's 'List of psychotropic substances' (NDPS Act and Rules, 1985, 2025 Edition) and 'NDPS Act and Rules, 1985 (updated 2026)' are image-only scans; the 2025 compilation would not load. India Code's consolidated Act (Last Update 3-1-2022) cannot be read past s. 53A. The Schedule was rebuilt from CBN's undated list of entries 1-111 plus each amending notification named in the note to S.O. 906(E).

Four Schedule amendments could not be read: S.O. 821(E) of 27 Feb 2018; S.O. 1352(E) of 13 Mar 2019; S.O. 1275(E) of 23 Mar 2021; and S.O. 5319(E) of 16 Nov 2022. From the numbering of the notifications read before and after them, these four hold entries 110P-110X, 110Z-110ZT and 110ZZB: 31 entries. The copies found were blocked by robots rules (narcoticsindia.nic.in; e-Gazette before 2026) or image-only (dor.gov.in). Every psychotropic marked 'Not found' is therefore draft. The NDPS Rules amendments of the same dates (G.S.R. 187(E) 2018 and G.S.R. 215(E) 2019, read once) add 4-MEC, ethylone, pentedrone, ethylphenidate, MPA, MDMB-CHMICA, 5F-APINACA, XLR-11 and Catha edulis (2018), and AB-CHMINACA, 5F-ADB, AB-PINACA, UR-144, 5F-PB-22 and 4-FA (2019), to Rules Schedule I. This does not give their Act entry numbers.

Manufactured drugs: no consolidated current list was found. Declarations read: 1985 and 1993 (CBN list), 2011, 2016, 2017, Sep 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026. Any others are unknown, e.g. S.O. 5318(E) of 16 Nov 2022, whose dor.gov.in copy is image-only. Carfentanil, furanylfentanyl and tapentadol therefore stay unsettled.
5F-MDMB-PINACA (5F-ADB) is in NDPS Rules Schedule I (entry 28, from G.S.R. 215(E) of 13 Mar 2019); its entry in the Schedule to the Act was not read.

DMT: CBN's list prints entry 3 as 'DMP' (so does the DGFT 2006 copy). The 1985 Gazette prints DMT (N,N-dimethyltryptamine) at that position. Recorded as DMT; editor to confirm against a current consolidated copy.
Esketamine: the Schedule names 'Ketamine' (110A); no isomer clause appears in the lists read. Whether esketamine is covered is for the editor.
CBN's base list (entries 1-111) is undated. No notification read omits any entry, but the four unread amendments were not checked for omissions.

CBN's copy of NDPS Rules Schedule I has entry 33 'DOC' without a footnote, and its footnotes stop at G.S.R. 215(E) of 13 Mar 2019. Later Rules amendments may be missing, e.g. G.S.R. 204(E) of 23 Mar 2021 (image-only).
